title: Add scene-local evidence for immediate audit continuity
description:
Problem

The playtest showed that the auditor relies heavily on tool evidence and does not sufficiently use recent accepted scene history. This makes immediate conversational follow-up brittle.

Example:
- Warden Sela says in an accepted response that she sent two scouts north and they did not return.
- The player immediately asks what to expect if investigating.
- A response referencing those scouts may still be rejected unless the model records or re-queries the fact.

Eshyra needs scene-local evidence that is weaker than durable campaign overlay lore but strong enough to support immediate local continuity.

Design direction

Introduce compact recent-scene evidence for audit/prompt context:
- accepted NPC statements
- recently established visible facts
- recently stated player-visible reports
- exact details that were accepted into narration, such as "three houses burned"

This should not replace record_world_fact for durable campaign memory. It should support immediate follow-up and prevent contradictions within the same scene.

Acceptance criteria

- Audit prompt receives a compact recent-scene evidence section derived only from accepted turns.
- Recent accepted NPC statements can support immediate follow-up dialogue.
- Recent accepted exact details remain available as scene-local evidence until the scene ends or ages out.
- Scene-local evidence is marked as weaker than module canon, campaign state, and campaign overlay lore.
- Durable consequential facts still require record_world_fact for long-term recall.
- Scene-local evidence does not allow failed tool calls or rejected candidate prose to become support.
- Regression:
  - Sela says two scouts did not return in an accepted turn.
  - Player immediately asks what to expect.
  - DM can reference the missing scouts without hard failure.
- Regression:
  - Accepted narration says three houses burned.
  - A same-scene follow-up can refer to three houses without a contradictory audit result.
- Regression:
  - After scene boundary/aging, durable recall requires overlay lore or module canon rather than stale scene-local context.
close_reason: Added recent accepted scene-log evidence to context assembly and audit prompts for immediate same-scene continuity.
